import datetime as dt
import humanize
# Test with very large deltas
try:
    result = humanize.naturaldelta(dt.timedelta(days=10**9))
    print('naturaldelta large:', repr(result))
except Exception as e:
    print('naturaldelta large error:', type(e).__name__, e)

try:
    result = humanize.naturaltime(dt.timedelta(days=10**9))
    print('naturaltime large:', repr(result))
except Exception as e:
    print('naturaltime large error:', type(e).__name__, e)

# Test precisedelta with year-level precision
try:
    result = humanize.precisedelta(dt.timedelta(days=400), minimum_unit='years')
    print('precisedelta years:', repr(result))
except Exception as e:
    print('precisedelta years error:', type(e).__name__, e)

try:
    result = humanize.precisedelta(dt.timedelta(days=365), minimum_unit='years')
    print('precisedelta 1 year:', repr(result))
except Exception as e:
    print('precisedelta 1 year error:', type(e).__name__, e)
"</｜DSML｜parameter>
